content.en: Deal each player one card, reveal one central Kobayakawa card, and make a draw deck. Play five rounds.
content.zh: 每人发 1 张手牌，中央翻开 1 张小早川牌，其余为牌堆。共玩 5 轮。

content.en: Choose once: draw a card and discard one of the two, or replace the central Kobayakawa with the deck top and take the old one. End with one hand card.
content.zh: 二选一：抽 1 张后从两张中弃 1 张；或用牌堆顶替换中央小早川，并拿走旧牌。最后只留 1 张手牌。

alt.en: Choose whether to redraw your hand or change Kobayakawa
alt.zh: 选择重抽手牌或改写小早川

content.en: In order, retreat or fight. Each fighter bets one coin. With two or more fighters, reveal for the showdown.
content.zh: 按顺序撤退或参战；每位参战者下注 1 枚钱币。两人以上参战则亮牌比拼。

content.en: Add central Kobayakawa only to the lowest fighting hand. Highest total takes the pot; ties go to the later fighter.
content.zh: 中央小早川只加给最低的参战手牌。结果最高者拿奖池；平手时较晚参战者获胜。

alt.en: Only the lowest fighting hand receives Kobayakawa
alt.zh: 只有最低参战手牌获得小早川

content.en: Reset cards and rotate the first player. After round five, most coins wins.
content.zh: 重置卡牌并轮换起始玩家。第五轮后，钱币最多者获胜。
